questions.current_reasoning: Major escalation in spending and GOP voter outreach ahead of the Aug 18 CA-14 special runoff (ABC7 San Francisco Aug 11, Washington Examiner Aug 12, East Bay Insiders Aug 6-7, CBS News Aug 13): super PAC outside spending for Melissa Hernandez / against Aisha Wahab has more than doubled since Aug 6 to over $5M ($4.4M+ from AIPAC-affiliated groups alone, including a $1.2M single-day TV buy by United Democracy Project on Aug 6), while July 1-29 FEC filings show Hernandez raised $900,435 and spent $796,970 vs Wahab's $56,467 raised and $137,453 spent—and Wahab has largely refrained from matching TV buys. Accepted Answer Format : The commonly used name of the armed group whose designation is updated.
